snippet.title: Final Fantasy XI Adventure for the GAME BOY! [Fan Demake]
snippet.description:
PLAY IT NOW over at
https://kazy.itch.io/ffxi-adventure !

A fan-made demake of FFXI for the Game Boy! Created in GB Studio.

The game features three starting nations, each with missions up to rank six! Over 30 of your favorite areas, and over 20 of your favorite music tracks redone on the Game Boy! (This is a REAL Gameboy ROM and will run on real Gameboy hardware!)


Get a boxed copy:
https://www.etsy.com/listing/693052650/fanmade-game-final-fantasy-xi-adventure

Final Fantasy XI is copyright Square Enix, this fan artwork is not endorsed or affiliated with them.
